title: Tree of luck – Nazar Eye, 1 dollar
descriptionPlain: Description Across many cultures, the symbol of the eye is believed to protect against the so-called evil eye and attract positive energy. In Turkey, it’s known as nazar; in Greece – matis; and around the world, it appears as a popular talisman of protection. In this remarkable silver coin, the motif is woven into an intricate tree design that connects spiritual strength with the forces of nature. The eye becomes a personal amulet, while the entire tree serves as a map of protective energy meant to accompany the collector every day.
